title: Venue Profile
description: VERIFY-stage C-path artifact. Output of venue-selector after the director has chosen a venue. Instantiates that venue's rubric into a scorecard: 7-dim weights, reject-triggers (with this-paper risk annotations), accept-condition, anti-bias suppressors, and the persona set. Consumed by venue-review-configurator (D2). Does NOT contain scores or a verdict — those are D2's job.

venue_id.description: Venue name or abbreviation (e.g. NeurIPS, MICCAI, TPAMI). Non-empty.

tier.description: Venue tier: conf = top ML conference; med = medical imaging venue; journal = archival journal.

paper_type.description: Paper type classification determining which dimensions are active and gating.

dimension_weights.description: Per-dimension rubric weights for this venue. Keys D1..D7. additionalProperties:false ensures only the 7 canonical dimensions exist.

D1.description: Soundness/correctness — hard gate for all tiers.

weight.description: Relative weight for this dimension at this venue.

gating.description: True if this dimension is a hard gate (failing it blocks accept).

D2.description: Significance/impact — journal gating; conf with novelty.

D3.description: Originality/novelty — high for all tiers; journal has conceptual-advance gate.

D4.description: Evaluation rigor/fairness — #1 reject driver; highest weight.

D5.description: Reproducibility — mandatory gate for journals; scored for conf.

D6.description: Clarity/presentation — medium weight for all tiers.

D7.description: Clinical/domain validity — active only for med/Nature Medicine; paper_type=application-clinical gate.

reject_triggers.description: Reject-triggers active for this venue, instantiated with this-paper risk annotation (our_risk). Any fired trigger blocks accept.

dimension.description: Which dimension this trigger maps to.

description.description: What condition fires this trigger. Non-empty.

our_risk.description: Optional: this paper's specific risk against this trigger (本稿对号入座). Present when venue-selector can identify the concrete risk.

accept_condition.description: The derivation rule for accept (echoed from rubric-7d). e.g. 'D1>=3 AND D4>=3 AND (D3>=3 OR D2>=3) AND no reject-trigger'. Non-empty.

anti_bias_suppressors.description: Not-valid-grounds for rejection at this venue (anti-bias guardrails). Empty list is allowed.

overall_scale.description: Optional: the overall score scale used at this venue (e.g. '1-6 NeurIPS', 'Accept/Minor/Major/Reject').

confidence_note.description: Optional: which rubric lines need login-state re-check before citing (from venue module §6 confidence annotations).

personas.description: Reviewer personas to activate for this venue (at least one required).

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers grounding this profile (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.
